cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Don’t Go
cards.instruction: Create reasons another player must stay with you. Never directly ask them to stay.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Before you get your train, could you taste this soup?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. I'll fix that. You'll need to check again.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My train leaves in ten minutes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Perfect. That's when the bread comes out.

mechanism: Treat a departing guest's soup judgment as a pupil's examination, converting each correction into another reason to remain without directly asking.
confusable: Not an ordinary request to taste food: A must turn B's successful answer and deadline into new stages of the claimed training.
comparison: Taste test and bread lesson differ from packing corrections and a useful rejected gift.
seedUse: Retains soup/salt/train/bread delay; grounds new stages in A's claimed teaching.
